**Date:** {{< meta display-date >}}  
**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Miss Smith](../persons.html#263),
I send the papers about [Sandwell](../others.html#12), and a back number of the [M P](../others.html#52), which please return. I have scarcely heard anything about the institution since I received this account from [Miss Goodrich](../persons.html#567) so my knowledge of it is two years old[^2]

yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Envelope addressed to Miss Ann Smith/ Rectory/ Old Charlton/ SE and postmarked Winchester (date torn) and London SE 7 March 1861.

[^2]: This letter identifies the A.M.G. who published \'Sandwell\' in MP (March 1859) 330-334, as Miss A. M.

Goodrich.
